name: SVG Optimizer
summary: Optimize SVG with SVGO in your browser — multipass, precision, pretty print, download.
description: Paste or upload SVG and run SVGO locally. Tune multipass, float precision, viewBox retention, xmlns removal, and pretty-print. See byte savings, preview the result, and download the optimized file. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Is this real SVGO?
faqs.answer: Yes. It uses the official SVGO browser build with the default preset, plus a few safe overrides you can toggle.

faqs.question: Why keep viewBox by default?
faqs.answer: Removing viewBox can break responsive scaling when width/height are present. Uncheck “Keep viewBox” if you want SVGO’s default removal behavior.

faqs.question: Is my SVG uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Optimization runs entirely in your browser.
